meta.title: Your account
meta.description: Track your requests, upload your documents once and keep your details ready for your next rental.

signIn.title: Your account
signIn.lede: Track your requests, upload your documents once and sign rental agreements online.
signIn.formTitle: Sign in or create an account
signIn.formText: We'll send you a one-time code. There's no password to remember.
signIn.phoneHint: We'll send your code to this number on WhatsApp.
signIn.emailHint: We'll send your code to this address.

benefits.requests: See every request and its status in one place.
benefits.documents: Upload your licence and ID once, before handover.
benefits.agreements: Sign your rental agreement online once we confirm.

signIn.deleted: Your account has been deleted from this device.

code.title: Enter your code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.resent: We've made a new code. The old one no longer works.

errors.format: Enter the 6 digits of your code.
errors.wrong: That code doesn't match. Check it and try again.
errors.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one.

code.message: Your LuxuryRentals.ae sign-in code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes.

errors.name: Enter your full name.

phone.uaeMobile: Enter a UAE mobile number starting with 5, for example 50 123 4567.
phone.invalid: Enter a valid phone number, including the area or mobile code.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.residentLicence: UAE residents need a UAE driving licence to rent. Choose "United Arab Emirates".
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.title: Your account
home.lede: Your requests, documents and details in one place.

requests.title: Your requests
requests.emptyText: Requests you send with this number or email show here, with their status.

intro.customer: Upload these once and we'll check them before handover. Bring the originals too: we check them and hand them straight back.
intro.ops: Check each file: the whole document is visible, it hasn't expired and the name matches the booking.

docs.formats: Photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC) or PDFs, up to 10 MB each.
docs.consentLabel: I agree that Luxuryrentals may use these documents to check that the driver can rent this car, as set out in the Privacy Notice. They are deleted after the rental.
docs.consentLabelLinked: I agree that Luxuryrentals may use these documents to check that the driver can rent this car, as set out in the [Privacy Notice](/legal/privacy). They are deleted after the rental.
docs.consentNeeded: Tick the box above to add your documents.
docs.consentGiven: You agreed to the document check on {when}.
docs.consentWithdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Your documents were deleted.
docs.noPhone: There's no phone number to keep documents with yet.

errors.type: Use a photo (JPG, PNG, HEIC) or a PDF.
errors.many: Add one file at a time.
errors.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

reasons.blurry: Photo is blurry or cut off
reasons.name: Name doesn't match the booking

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: We use these details to pre-fill your next request.
profile.name: Full name
profile.nameHint: As it appears on your driving licence.
profile.phoneHint: We'll message you about your requests on this number. Your documents are kept with it.
profile.phoneMoves: Your documents move to the new number. Requests sent with the old number stay linked to it.
profile.idp: Visitors with a licence from this country also need an International Driving Permit (IDP).
profile.resident: Do you live in the UAE?
profile.under25: To drive our cars yourself you need to be 25 or older. Our chauffeur service has no age limit.
profile.saved: Saved. Your next request form is pre-filled with these details.
profile.needPhone: Add your WhatsApp number to your profile first. Your documents are kept with it.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.text: Removes your profile and the details of your uploaded documents from this device. Requests you've already sent aren't affected.
delete.confirmText: Your profile and the details of your uploaded documents will be removed. Requests you've already sent stay as they are. You can create a new account at any time.
